effect: The hand test confirms that the linked jaws close around the block and the band reopens them; remote control remains for later.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the jaw links was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how spreading short arms close the long jaw tips.

leastWorthwhile.text: The syringe preparation and attachment felt like routine assembly, with little explanation of their purpose in this chapter.

surprise.text: I was interested that the short arms spread while the jaw tips close, with each link pivoting independently.

arbitrary.text: The syringe's role remained unclear because the finished grabber was tested by hand; its setup felt premature, though Jo hints at a later use.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the syringe controls the grabber from the other end; the linkage was interesting enough to make me curious.
